terra.problem: “Jesus baptizes” could be misleading: John 3:22 says Jesus baptized, but John 4:2 clarifies that His disciples did the baptizing. The title and text could say that His disciples baptized, with John 4:2 added as a reference.
For a 5th-grade reading level, consider explaining “Magi,” “repent,” “disciples,” and “persecution” in simpler words.
